checks.quote: The NuMI decay pipe is 2 m in diameter and 675 m in length within a larger excavated tunnel.

geometry.locator: NuMI Facility TDR (FERMILAB-DESIGN-1998-01) Appendix A, beam sheet 'Site coordinates for beamline: horn2.ces' (DUSAF x, y in ft; station along the beam in ft)

method: Published coordinates converted to WGS 84: beam-sheet rows DECAY (station 1307.48377 ft, x = 100185.345, y = 97855.370) and DENCU (station 3522.04627 ft, x = 98230.009, y = 98887.039); the station difference is 2214.56 ft = 675.0 m. Conversion of DUSAF to WGS 84: DUSAF x, y (ft) are the FSCS coordinates of Beams-doc-1148 (origin A0 = 41°50′14.312704″ N, 88°15′41.143123″ W, false x = y = 100000 ft, +y axis at geodetic azimuth 38°16′48.01429″, scale 1.000029251 at A0), applied as a rotated tangent plane on the GRS80 ellipsoid (difference to the double stereographic projection below 0.2 m within 1.5 km of A0). NAD83 and WGS 84 are taken as equal.
name: NuMI decay tunnel and decay pipe (675 m)

summary.plain: The 675 m long, 2 m wide decay pipe in which particles from the NuMI target decay into neutrinos, inside its tunnel.
